note: vendor/engine/ and vendor/ui/ are a FORK, not a mirror. They started as
verbatim copies of agent-core pinned at 95d5e8b (v0.3.1, 2026-08-05),
were three-way merged up to 1bc3c71 on 2026-08-18 and to main HEAD
10fdab3 on 2026-08-19, and are edited directly ever since. There is no
sync script and no patch directory: change these files the way you
would change any other file in this repository. To merge future
upstream work, three-way merge per file with `git merge-file` (base =
the commit above, theirs = upstream main, ours = the file here).
The 10fdab3 merge brought the compaction data-loss fix (request views +
pre-compaction archive generations), model_caps + reasoning effort, the
task tool's structured reports and per-task cancel, and the UI for all
of it. Two upstream commits in that range were SKIPPED as inapplicable:
5ecc29a (search_skills prompt guidance -- this fork registers no
search_skills/install_skill model tools) and 345721e (shared default
API key fallback in config.rs -- config here is injected at build
time, there is no built-in shared key).
2026-08-24: ported the sub-agent timeout/reporting fixes from an
agent-core working-copy snapshot (post-10fdab3, uncommitted there yet).
Taken: agent_task.rs soft-deadline wrap-up (steer channel + a wrap_up
select arm that nudges the child to write its final report before the

why_a_copy_at_all: agent-core is a single crate with no feature boundary between the engine
and its actix/rusqlite/PTY host layer, so `cargo build --target
wasm32-unknown-unknown` fails inside mio before reaching any of its own
code. The files below are the subset that compiles for wasm32 after the
browser adaptations that are now baked into the sources (wasmtimer for
clocks, crate::vfs for std::fs, no worker threads).
The engine set is very nearly closed: the loop files reference only each
other, plus three host modules they reach by name rather than by import.
Each of those three is answered by a module of ours under the path
upstream uses, so the copies compile:
crate::config          -- four default() functions out of upstream's 617
lines; the browser's config arrives injected.
crate::web::store      -- SessionStore, aliased to the SqliteStore name
the engine's `store` field is declared with.
crate::releases        -- the theme half; a page cannot serve
/theme/assets/, so the asset half is absent
(see crates/agent-web-core/src/releases.rs).
Upstream's #[cfg(test)] blocks are not carried: they need dev-dependencies
this crate has no reason to have (tempfile, tokio's full feature set), and
they set fixtures up through std::fs while the code under test reads
through the in-memory VFS. crates/agent-web-core/tests/ covers this side.

files.role: Tool trait + registry (the browser port seam)
the `task` tool: sub-agents in child loops
set_chat_style: the model restyles the page
OsPolicy, the audit decorator, tool registration
open_terminal: the button that opens the console

ui.role: @vinx/agent-chat, source and all; the page build compiles it
note: Forked with the engine at the same commit. The source is kept rather
than a built dist/, so what is committed is reviewable and no build
output is in git. package-lock.json is committed beside it because
`npm ci` refuses to run without one.
2026-09-06: three-way synced with the xcore fork's ui/src (see fork.note
and docs/UPSTREAM.md item 5). Vinx-specific i18n keys were renamed onto
the names that fork uses for the same thing: vinxAgent -> defaultBrand,

never_taken.src/config.rs: 617 lines of load/save around a few structs; the browser gets its config injected, so agent-web-core declares its own with the four defaults the engine reads.
never_taken.src/os/shell.rs: there is no shell in a page or on the gateway; the device's run_python tool is the equivalent, and it takes SafeAllowList and /api/safe-commands with it.
never_taken.src/os/publish.rs: copies a file into a served public bucket. Nothing here serves one.
never_taken.src/web/store.rs: rusqlite bundled (C). Reimplemented over sqlite-wasm-rs with the same schema, and aliased to the SqliteStore name the engine names.
never_taken.src/web/actix.rs: there is no server in a browser; the routes become an in-page fetch shim.
